evidence.reason: After edit, ignores units and returns metering.historySize() instead of a charge, so subscriptionCharge(40) is no longer guaranteed > 0 as the test requires.
Right edit adds early return 0 for units === 0; combined with left edit calling evaluate(0, ...), the charge path returns 0, further undermining any positive-charge expectation.
Test asserts subscriptionCharge(40) > 0 and evaluate(20, 0.1, "monthly") > 0; merged behavior no longer satisfies the subscriptionCharge assertion.

result.userExplanation: 左侧改动把 subscriptionCharge 改成忽略 units 并返回 historySize()，与测试中 subscriptionCharge(40) > 0 的预期冲突，且与右侧 usageCharge 的零值提前返回叠加后行为不可靠。
result.suggestedAction: 请修改 src/subscription.ts 中的 subscriptionCharge，恢复对 units 的计费计算（例如保留 metering.initialize() 与 metering.evaluate(units, 0.1, "monthly") / metering.chargeUnit），不要返回 historySize()。
